question.text: In the same Pay-for-Success through Grants structure, if the NPO does NOT achieve the pre-defined outcomes AND the pre-defined time period is over, the CSR capital in the escrow is:

answer.text: Refunded to the CSR funder without any onward deployment.
Paid to the interim funding partner as compensation for non-performance.
Routed to items provided under Schedule VII of the Companies Act such as the PM's Relief Fund.
Transferred to the SSE Investor Protection Fund.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook's Chapter 2 pay-for-success through grants discussion (pp.63-64), if the NPO has not achieved outcomes and the pre-defined time period is over, the CSR capital is routed to items provided under Schedule VII of the Companies Act such as the PM's Relief Fund. If the time period is NOT yet over, it rolls over in escrow. The Trap: Option A removes the onward deployment requirement. Option B rewards non-performance. Option D invents a fund that is not used for CSR under-performance. Note: The escrow rollover-versus-Schedule-VII routing rule on pp.63-64 is the operative source; do not extrapolate beyond it.
